status: research_vectors_awaiting_independent_sanskrit_review. The arithmetic vectors are stronger than the usual delineation vector: where the 1899 printing works its own example, the vector carries the printed inputs and the printed result, so a failure is a failure against the SOURCE and not against the encoder's reading of it. Every rendering remains engine_translation_unreviewed.
required_expansion_before_implementation: independent Sanskrit review of every cited sloka before any rule is promoted out of research_only

the engine does not compute exact local sunrise/sunset, ghati-based ishta-kala, day and night length, or the sayana (tropical) longitude required by natonnata-bala, tribhaga-bala, varsha/masa/dina/hora-bala and ayana-bala; these four kala-bala limbs and ayana-bala are unevaluable until those inputs exist
the engine does not compute madhyama (mean) longitudes or sighrocca, which cheshta-bala requires
collate the saptavargaja values and the required-minimum table against the Sharma and Santhanam recensions, which print different numbers
